title: Prescribed--Energy Connecting Orbits for Quasilinear Conservative Systems
summary: We consider quasilinear conservative systems \[ (φ(|\dot q|)\dot q)'=\nabla V(q), \qquad q\in\R^{N}, \] with $Φ$-growth kinetic term and potential $V\in C^{1}(\R^{N};\R)$. Assuming that for some $c\in\R$ the sublevel set $\{V\le c\}$ splits into two disjoint closed subsets $\mathcal V_c^{-}$ and $\mathcal V_c^{+}$, we prove the existence of trajectories $q_c$ with prescribed energy $-c$ connecting $\mathcal V_c^{-}$ and $\mathcal V_c^{+}$, obtained through an energy-constrained variational method.
